Kolosefoɔ yiedie ho mmɔdemmɔ
1Na mepɛ sɛ mohunu aperepereɛ denden a medi no mo ne wɔn a wɔwɔ Laodikea ne wɔn a wɔnhunu m’anim ɔhonam mu nyinaa ho, 2sɛ wɔnnya deɛ ɛka wɔn akoma to wɔn yam, ɛne sɛ wɔnyɛ baako ɔdɔ mu, nnya nteaseɛ a wɔasi so dua ahonya nyinaa, na wɔahunu Nyankopɔn ahuntasɛm a ɛne Kristo no mu. 3#1 Ko 1.24; 1.30 Ɔno mu na wɔde nyansa ne nimdeɛ agyapadeɛ nyinaa akora.
Paulo dɔ
4 # Rom 16.18 Na meka yei na obi amfa nnaadaasɛm anto mo bradɛ. 5#1 Ko 5.3; 14.40 Na sɛ menni hɔ wɔ honam mu mpo a, me ne mo wɔ hɔ honhom mu, na m’ani gye sɛ mehunu mo kwan a mogyina soɔ ne mo gyidie a ɛkɔ Kristo mu tim a atim no.
Wɔn honhom nkɔsoɔ ho nsiyɛ
6Enti sɛdeɛ mogyee Awurade Kristo Yesu no, monnante ne mu saa ara, 7#Efe 3.17; 2.22 sɛ wɔn a wɔagye nhini, na wɔde wɔn asi ne soɔ, na wɔayɛ den gyidie mu, sɛdeɛ wɔkyerɛkyerɛɛ mo no, na wɔboro so, aseda mu.
Kristo nyameyɛ
8 # Kol 2.20 Monhwɛ yie na obi amfa nyansapɛ ne nnaadaa hunu a ɛnam nnipa atetesɛm ne wiase honhom mu nsɛm nkyerɛkyerɛ soɔ, na ɛnnam Kristo so, ammɛfa mo nnommum; 9#Yoh 1.14; 1.16 ɛfiri sɛ Kristo mu na Onyame ankasa mayɛ nyinaa teɛ nipadua mu, 10#Efe 1.21 na moayɛ ma wɔ ne mu: Ɔno na ɔyɛ mpaninnie ne tumidie nyinaa ti, 11#1 Pe 3.21; Rom 2.29 ɔno mu na wɔatwa mo twetia a wɔamfa nsa antwa, na deɛ ɛwɔ honam nipadua mu a wɔyi gu hɔ no, wɔayi no wɔ Kristo twetiatwa mu. 12#Rom 6.4; Kol 3.1 Na wɔasie mo ne no wɔ asubɔ mu, na ne mu na mo ne no nso anyane. Ɛnam gyidie a ɛwɔ Onyankopɔn a ɔnyanee no firii awufoɔ mu no tumi adwuma so.
Kristo mpatadwuma
13 # Efe 2.1; 2.5 Na mo a anka moyɛ awufoɔ, ɛsiane mo mfomsoɔ ne mo honam a twetiatwa nni mu no nti, wama mo ne no anya nkwa bi, sɛ ɔnam adom so de mfomsoɔ nyinaa akyɛ yɛn, 14#Efe 2.15 na wapepa ahyɛdeɛ no mu atwerɛ a ɛtia yɛn no, na ɔde akɔbɔ asɛnnua ho de ayi afiri kwan mu, 15#Kol 1.13 na watu mpaninnie ne tumidie agu ayi wɔn adi akyerɛ pefee wɔ badwam de adi wɔn so nkonim wɔ mu.
Ntamgyinafoɔ foforɔ biara nni hɔ
16 # Rom 14.1-12 Enti mommma obi mmmu mo atɛn aduane anaa anonneɛ anaa afahyɛ anaa ɔsrane foforɔ anaa home nna fam, 17#Heb 8.5; 10.1 na yeinom yɛ nnoɔma a ɛbɛba no ho mfonini bi ara, na deɛ ɛdi mu ara ankasa no ne Kristo. 18#Kol 2.23 Mommma obi mfa anisoɔ ahobrɛaseɛ ne abɔfosom mmma nkonimboɔ no mmɔ mo, sɛ ɔkura nnoɔma a wahunu pɛn mu, na ɔhoran kwa wɔ ne honam adwene mu, 19#Efe 4.15-16 nanso ɔnsɔ tire no a nipadua no nyinaa firi mu nam akwaa ne ntini biara so nya aduane na wɔtoatoa mu nyini wɔ nyini a ɛfiri Nyankopɔn mu no.
Mmara sodie nko ara nnɔɔso
20 # Gal 4.3; 4.9 Enti sɛ mo ne Kristo anya awu afiri wiase honhom mu nsɛm nkyerɛkyerɛ ho a, adɛn nti na mode ahyɛdeɛ to mo ho soɔ sɛdeɛ moda so te wiase 21sɛ: Nsɔ mu, nka nhwɛ, mfa wo nsa nka! 22#Yes 29.13; Mat 15.9 Saa nnoɔma yi nyinaa yɛ deɛ ɛkyerɛ nnoɔma hunu wɔ nnipa ahyɛdeɛ ne nkyerɛkyerɛ famu nko. 23#Rom 13.14; 1 Ti 4.3 Deɛ nnoɔma yi yɛ ara ne sɛ, ɛkyerɛ nyansa wɔ anisoɔ som ne ahobrɛaseɛ ne atirimuɔden a wɔyɛ no honam so deɛ, na yeinom nyinaa mfa mfasoɔ mma na mmom ne nyinaa yɛ deɛ ɛhyɛ honam akɔnnɔ ma.

pageProps.chapterText:
Na mepɛ sɛ mohunu aperepereɛ denden a medi no mo ne wɔn a wɔwɔ Laodikea ne wɔn a wɔnhunu m’anim ɔhonam mu nyinaa ho, sɛ wɔnnya deɛ ɛka wɔn akoma to wɔn yam, ɛne sɛ wɔnyɛ baako ɔdɔ mu, nnya nteaseɛ a wɔasi so dua ahonya nyinaa, na wɔahunu Nyankopɔn ahuntasɛm a ɛne Kristo no mu. Ɔno mu na wɔde nyansa ne nimdeɛ agyapadeɛ nyinaa akora.

Na meka yei na obi amfa nnaadaasɛm anto mo bradɛ. Na sɛ menni hɔ wɔ honam mu mpo a, me ne mo wɔ hɔ honhom mu, na m’ani gye sɛ mehunu mo kwan a mogyina soɔ ne mo gyidie a ɛkɔ Kristo mu tim a atim no.

Enti sɛdeɛ mogyee Awurade Kristo Yesu no, monnante ne mu saa ara, sɛ wɔn a wɔagye nhini, na wɔde wɔn asi ne soɔ, na wɔayɛ den gyidie mu, sɛdeɛ wɔkyerɛkyerɛɛ mo no, na wɔboro so, aseda mu.

Monhwɛ yie na obi amfa nyansapɛ ne nnaadaa hunu a ɛnam nnipa atetesɛm ne wiase honhom mu nsɛm nkyerɛkyerɛ soɔ, na ɛnnam Kristo so, ammɛfa mo nnommum; ɛfiri sɛ Kristo mu na Onyame ankasa mayɛ nyinaa teɛ nipadua mu, na moayɛ ma wɔ ne mu: Ɔno na ɔyɛ mpaninnie ne tumidie nyinaa ti, ɔno mu na wɔatwa mo twetia a wɔamfa nsa antwa, na deɛ ɛwɔ honam nipadua mu a wɔyi gu hɔ no, wɔayi no wɔ Kristo twetiatwa mu. Na wɔasie mo ne no wɔ asubɔ mu, na ne mu na mo ne no nso anyane. Ɛnam gyidie a ɛwɔ Onyankopɔn a ɔnyanee no firii awufoɔ mu no tumi adwuma so.

Na mo a anka moyɛ awufoɔ, ɛsiane mo mfomsoɔ ne mo honam a twetiatwa nni mu no nti, wama mo ne no anya nkwa bi, sɛ ɔnam adom so de mfomsoɔ nyinaa akyɛ yɛn, na wapepa ahyɛdeɛ no mu atwerɛ a ɛtia yɛn no, na ɔde akɔbɔ asɛnnua ho de ayi afiri kwan mu, na watu mpaninnie ne tumidie agu ayi wɔn adi akyerɛ pefee wɔ badwam de adi wɔn so nkonim wɔ mu.

Enti mommma obi mmmu mo atɛn aduane anaa anonneɛ anaa afahyɛ anaa ɔsrane foforɔ anaa home nna fam, na yeinom yɛ nnoɔma a ɛbɛba no ho mfonini bi ara, na deɛ ɛdi mu ara ankasa no ne Kristo. Mommma obi mfa anisoɔ ahobrɛaseɛ ne abɔfosom mmma nkonimboɔ no mmɔ mo, sɛ ɔkura nnoɔma a wahunu pɛn mu, na ɔhoran kwa wɔ ne honam adwene mu, nanso ɔnsɔ tire no a nipadua no nyinaa firi mu nam akwaa ne ntini biara so nya aduane na wɔtoatoa mu nyini wɔ nyini a ɛfiri Nyankopɔn mu no.

Enti sɛ mo ne Kristo anya awu afiri wiase honhom mu nsɛm nkyerɛkyerɛ ho a, adɛn nti na mode ahyɛdeɛ to mo ho soɔ sɛdeɛ moda so te wiase sɛ: Nsɔ mu, nka nhwɛ, mfa wo nsa nka! Saa nnoɔma yi nyinaa yɛ deɛ ɛkyerɛ nnoɔma hunu wɔ nnipa ahyɛdeɛ ne nkyerɛkyerɛ famu nko. Deɛ nnoɔma yi yɛ ara ne sɛ, ɛkyerɛ nyansa wɔ anisoɔ som ne ahobrɛaseɛ ne atirimuɔden a wɔyɛ no honam so deɛ, na yeinom nyinaa mfa mfasoɔ mma na mmom ne nyinaa yɛ deɛ ɛhyɛ honam akɔnnɔ ma.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
